title: Email all nursery volunteers
summary: Find your nursery team, check who will receive the message, and send a group email.

steps.title: Open Tags
paragraphs: Sign in to Mercy PCA’s Tithely account and click “Tags” at the top. Mercy PCA organizes groups by tag, and each tag lists the people in that group.

images.alt: Tithely’s top navigation with the Tags tab selected next to Giving.
images.caption: Find Tags in the top navigation.

steps.title: Select the Nursery Volunteers tag
paragraphs: Open the “Children’s Ministries” folder, then select the “Nursery Volunteers” tag.

steps.title: Click Email People
paragraphs: Check that the page heading says “Nursery Volunteers,” then click “Email People” on the right to open an email to that group.

images.alt: Nursery Volunteers tag page with the Email People option to the right of the volunteer list.
images.caption: Email People is on the right side of the Nursery Volunteers page.

steps.title: Write your message
paragraphs: In “Compose Message,” check the Bcc line to make sure you’re emailing the nursery volunteers. Fill in “Subject,” then type your message in the large box below.
To include a file, click “Add Attachment” and select the file you want to send.

images.alt: Compose Message window with the Bcc line, Subject field, message editor, and Add Attachment option.
images.caption: Enter the subject and message in Compose Message.

steps.title: Send now or schedule for later
paragraphs: Review the recipients, subject, message, and any attachments. Click “Send” to send the email right away.
To send it later, click the arrow next to “Send.” Choose one of the suggested times or select “Send at Custom Date/Time” to set your own.

images.alt: Send menu showing immediate delivery, suggested times, and Send at Custom Date/Time.
images.caption: The arrow next to Send opens the scheduling options.
